up: Retrieve all IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against human ATP-dependent translocase ABCB1. For each activity, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, target name, and target organism. Include only activities where the compound has a canonical SMILES and the associated document has a PubMed ID or DOI.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  act.standard_value AS ic50_value_nM
FROM activities act
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND td.pref_name = 'ATP-dependent translocase ABCB1'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
